subject.title: fix(channels): progress drafts only for long tasks, with the model's own preamble as the status headline

question: Should Discord and Telegram progress mode always replace the implicit status label with the model's freshest preamble without a new configuration option?
rationale: This changes the default presentation for existing progress-mode users, and correctness repairs cannot determine the permanent UX contract.

options.title: Approve after repairs
options.body: Keep the always-on headline design, but require the three lifecycle and accounting fixes plus live channel proof before merge.

options.title: Make it opt-in
options.body: Add a narrowly scoped progress-headline setting so existing users retain the current presentation unless they enable model preambles.

options.title: Split the feature
options.body: Land only delayed startup and deferred narration now, then handle the headline behavior in a separately sponsored change.

recommendation.title: Approve after repairs
recommendation.body: Keep the always-on headline design, but require the three lifecycle and accounting fixes plus live channel proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked issue and PR establish the proposed UX direction, and recent channel history makes this the best available routing candidate.
